name: Eógan mac Durthacht

attributes.attribute: gave Deirdre to Eógan in anger

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Eógan mac Durthacht killed the hero Nóisiu. This happened in the tale of Deirdre of the Sorrows. That tale is one of the Three Sorrows of Ireland. King Concobar Mac Nessa gave Deirdre to Eógan in anger. She preferred death to life without Nóisiu and died at the chariot. Eógan appears in other legends in supporting roles.

okr.objective: Rewrite the Eógan mac Durthacht entry with its Ulster Cycle role.
key_results: Name him as the killer of Nóisiu
Tie him to the Three Sorrows of Ireland
Record Deirdre's death from the chariot
